title: The shape of freedom
summary: Can a woman be legally independent without being financially independent? Rights on paper are only part of the story. This essay looks at the relationship between financial agency and the freedom to make a life on your own terms.

title: The workplace harassment law, in plain language
summary: A guide to the Indian framework for prevention, prohibition and redressal. The POSH Act creates duties for workplaces and a process for complaints of sexual harassment. This guide maps the main parts of that framework without replacing the statute or professional advice.

title: Independence is not a single moment
summary: On the small, everyday choices that make autonomy real. A personal essay on autonomy as a practice shaped by ordinary decisions, relationships and the room people are given to change their minds.

title: Vishaka v. State of Rajasthan
summary: How should workplace sexual harassment be addressed when there is no specific domestic legislation? The Supreme Court treated workplace sexual harassment as a violation of constitutional guarantees and issued guidelines for workplaces pending legislation. Parliament later enacted the 2013 POSH Act.

title: Pratibha Rani v. Suraj Kumar
summary: Can allegations about a married woman's stridhan raise a criminal breach of trust issue? The Supreme Court held that the complaint could proceed. It recognized that a woman's stridhan is her property and that entrustment and dishonest misappropriation may be relevant to a criminal breach of trust allegation, subject to proof and the applicable law.

title: Vineeta Sharma v. Rakesh Sharma
summary: How does the 2005 amendment to section 6 of the Hindu Succession Act affect daughters' coparcenary rights? The Court held that the amended section 6 confers coparcenary status on a daughter by birth, in the same manner as a son, with the same rights and liabilities. It also held that the father's being alive on 9 September 2005 is not a requirement. Statutory limits and prior transactions still matter.
